story_type: rocket falls back onto its pad and explodes seconds after liftoff, historic color film
hook: Seconds after liftoff, it fell back onto the pad.
narration: Seconds after liftoff, this rocket fell back and exploded.
It was an Atlas Centaur test flight at Cape Kennedy in March 1965.
A fuel valve failed, and it rose only a few feet.
Atlas Centaur was built to launch Surveyor, a robot lander sent to find out whether the Moon's surface could hold up an Apollo spacecraft.
outcome: On a later flight every system worked perfectly, setting the stage for the Surveyor launch.
title: Rocket fell back and exploded, 1965
question_comment: Would you have been in the blockhouse for the next launch?

facts.claim: Fuel valve malfunction, rose only a few feet, March test flight
facts.source_quote: In a research and development test flight in March, a fuel valve malfunctions and centaur arrays only a few feet.
The surveyor will be boosted into space by an Atlas centaur.

facts.claim: Surveyor to test whether surface supports Apollo
facts.source_quote: Is the moon's surface solid enough to support the Apollo spacecraft?
In a later flight, all systems perform perfectly, setting the stage for the surveyor launching.

description:
An Atlas Centaur rises only a few feet on a March 1965 test flight from Cape Kennedy after a fuel valve malfunction, falls back and explodes; a later flight cleared the way for the Surveyor Moon landers.
